text: Databases store and organise information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, while NoSQL databases store data in flexible forms like documents. When working with a database, we write queries to ask for specific information. Good data modelling helps us plan how data connects before we build anything. Indexes make searches much faster, especially in large tables. Choosing between SQL and NoSQL depends on your needs. SQL works well for structured data, and NoSQL is better for changing or unstructured data.
